successors.name: British Empire in India (East India Company rule)
successors.text: Palamu, the core of the Chero chieftaincy (modern Palamu and Latehar districts)

ledger.x: 1572: Bhagwant Rai drives the Raksels out and the Cheros take Palamu.
1813: the chieftaincy, bankrupt under Churaman Rai, passes to Company rule; its zamindari confiscated.
